_about: Frame-check tolerances for tools/run.py (MGA-Glide's tools/imgcmp.py options: tol per channel after RGB565 quantisation, frac of pixels allowed beyond it, edge ignores colour edges of the reference). Per kind, then per test.

Q2D1P._why: Quake 2 turns 32-bit texels back into palette indices through pics/16to8.dat (GL_BuildPalettedTexture), so colours outside its palette move to the nearest entry

cards._about: Per card (the output directory's name), per test, over any kind: what the card cannot draw the same way.

S1BLND._why: the G100 blends by stipple (MGA-Glide D8, DOS-GL likewise): compared through a 4x4 box filter, as in MGA-Glide's conformance manifest

L1LQ2P._why: the second pass multiplies by the destination, which the G100 cannot do: MGA-Glide skips it (D8), DOS-GL supports the G100 for development only
